title: Symmetry breaking and skyrmionic transport in twisted bilayer graphene
verdict: STRONG PARTIAL / REPLICATED (analytic sigma-model argument). Claim 1 (skyrmion energy ~ 4*pi*rho_s Belavin-Polyakov baseline) reproduced quantitatively (12.537 vs 12.566, 0.24% error, scale-invariant). Claim 2 (non-monotonic activation gap Delta(B) and non-monotonic magnetoresistance R(B) from Zeeman-shifted skyrmion transport) reproduced qualitatively: skyrmion channel Delta_sk has an interior minimum at b~0.125, R(B)/R(0) has an interior peak at b~0.064. Absolute field/energy units NOT predicted (require self-consistent Hartree-Fock of the continuum model, explicitly out of scope) -> PARTIAL on quantitative side.
scope: Analytic O(3)/CP^1 nonlinear sigma-model skyrmion energetics only. Full self-consistent Hartree-Fock of the BM continuum flat bands out of scope.
